issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) declares SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) as returning void, but the solution implementation declares orderMeal(Meal) to return boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature to implement and may cause tests or grading harnesses that expect a void method to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across artifacts. Either change the solution implementation to declare public void orderMeal(Meal meal) (and keep its current behavior, removing or ignoring the boolean return), or update the problem statement and UML to specify that orderMeal returns boolean. Preferably follow the problem statement (void) so student-facing specification and tests match.
